ILLAGE OARD OF RUSTEES
OFFICIAL NOTICE & AGENDA
THIS AGENDA SHALL SERVE AS NOTICE FOR THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE VILLAGE OF RIB MOUNTAIN
BOARD OF TRUSTEES, WHICH IS TO BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 17, 2026, MEETING AT 6:00 P.M. AT THE VILLAGE
OF RIB MOUNTAIN MUNICIPAL CENTER, 227800 SNOWBIRD AVENUE. SAID MEETING SHALL BE CALLED IN
ACCORDANCE WITH WIS. STATS. §19.83 AND §19.84. OTHER COMMISSIONS AND COMMITTEES OF THE
VILLAGE MAY ATTEND FOR PURPOSES OF GATHERING INFORMATION. SUBJECT MATTER FOR CONSIDERATION
AND POSSIBLE ACTION FOLLOWS:
1. Call to Order – Pledge of Allegiance – Roll Call
2. Comments From the Public Related to Agenda Items
3. Discussion and Action on Minutes of the 10/20/26 Special Budget #4 Meeting and 11/5/26 Rescheduled
Regular Meeting
4. Acknowledgement of November 11, 2026, Plan Commission Minutes
5. Discussion and Action on Approval of 2026 General and Debt Levy Payable in 2027
6. Discussion and Action on Resolution # 26-12 Adoption of the Village Tax Levy
7. Discussion and Action on Approval of FY 2027 Budget and 5-Year Capital Plan
8. Discussion and Action on Resolution # 26-14 Establishing Water Property Tax Equivalent for Water Utility
9. Discussion and Action on Marathon County Humane Society Non-Dog Stray Impoundment 2027 Agreement
10. Discussion and Action on Amendment to E-Plan Exam Agreement
11. Discussion and Action on Resolution #26-13 2027 Fee Schedule
12. Discussion and Action on League Mutual Insurance Services
13. Discussion and Action on APS Morning Glory Lane
14. Discussion and Action on Contract with MSA for Traffic Study
15. Discussion and Action on Operators License
16. Discussion and Action on Alcohol and Cigarette License
17. Reports by Board Members, Outside Agencies, Attorney, and Staff
18. Commission & Committee Reports
19. General Comments
20. Adjourn
Allen Opall (LK) 11/13/2026
Village President Date
